component.name: DriftFolderSync
component.summary: Real-time two-way folder sync with Google Drive

description.p: DriftFolderSync keeps local folders and folders in your Google Drive accounts in sync, in both directions, as files change. It is an independent, unofficial client that uses only Google's public Drive API with your own OAuth credentials.

ul.li: Two-way mirroring, or upload-only backup / download-only modes
Several Google accounts, each with its own folders
Real-time, or batched every N minutes to limit API calls
Low-overhead inotify monitoring and API rate limiting
Selective sync, exclude patterns, conflict handling, recoverable deletes
Shared drives, Google Docs link files, bandwidth limits, proxy support

description.p: Google Drive is a trademark of Google LLC. DriftFolderSync is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google.
